description: This file defines the VariableSubstitutionRule class, a utility class used for transforming panel configurations within the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM framework. It extends BaseRule and provides methods to modify panel layouts for different views like DetailView and EditView, substituting certain field definitions with customized code or alternative field references based on pattern matching.

classes.name: VariableSubstitutionRule
classes.description: A utility class for transforming panel configurations with rule-based substitutions in SuiteCRM/SugarCRM.

methods.name: parsePanels
methods.description: Transforms the panel layout array based on the view type ('DetailView' or 'EditView') by pattern matching columns and replacing them with specialized definitions or code snippets.
